description: Source code for the HTML report generator in Playwright, implementing the ReporterV2 interface, handling report building, server setup, and file processing.

classes.name: HtmlReporter
classes.description: Implements the ReporterV2 interface for generating HTML reports, managing report lifecycle, configuration, and output.

classes.name: HtmlBuilder
classes.description: Builds the HTML report, processes test data, creates report files, and manages embedded data ZIP.

classes.name: Base64Encoder
classes.description: Stream transformer encoding data to Base64, used for embedding ZIP data into HTML.

methods.name: reportFolderFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves report folder path from environment variables.

methods.name: getHtmlReportOptionProcessEnv
methods.description: Gets HTML report open option from environment variables, with validation.

methods.name: showHTMLReport
methods.description: Starts a local server and opens the HTML report in a browser.

methods.name: startHtmlReportServer
methods.description: Creates an HTTP server to serve report files.
